title_en: Order of the State Council on the Unified Implementation of Legal Metrological Units in China

articles.content_en: 1. The units of measurement in our country shall uniformly adopt the Legal Units of Measurement of the People's Republic of China (attached).

2. The market system units of measurement currently used in people's daily life in our country may continue to be used until 1990, and the transition to the national legal units of measurement shall be completed by the end of 1990. The reform of the unit of measurement for farmland area shall be formulated on the basis of investigation and study, and shall be announced separately.

3. The reform of units of measurement is a matter involving all trades and industries and the broad masses of the people. All localities and departments shall attach full importance to it, formulate active and stable implementation plans, and ensure its smooth completion.
